finalMobileReport.subMeta: Anna · 8 Apr 2026 – 2 Jun 2026 · 91.1% of days logged
finalMobileReport.lede: Your afternoons got steadier. Here's what your own data — not a study average — suggests worked for you.

tiles.label: Days with a noticeable or severe afternoon crash

factors.title: What worked for you
factors.sub: Extra afternoon energy on the days you did each rule.

keepList.title: Your keep list
keepList.body: These two tracked most closely with your better afternoons. Worth keeping. You can park meditation and the caffeine delay, or revisit them later.

compare.title: How you compare
compare.body: Kind explorers improved afternoon energy by about 1.1 points on average. Your +1.6 puts you a little ahead of the community — and you logged more consistently as most (91.1% vs ~78%). The rule most followed across the community is Morning sunlight.

finalMobileReport.disclaimer: This reflects your experience over eight weeks — not a medical diagnosis. Sleep, stress, and everyday life shape afternoons too. Treat these findings as a personal hint about what may help you, not proof.

limitations: These results describe your experience only — they are not medical evidence and may not apply to others.
